newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Maxim Group raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Maxim Group raised.

text.p: Interstate Johnson Lane said it raised its rating on Maxim Group Inc stock to neutral from sell.

-- cited the company's first-quarter earnings improvement and encouraging signs about future performance. On Wedneday, Maxim said its first-quarter earnings climbed to $0.20 a share from $0.08 in the year-earlier period.
-- said the company's managment appears to be strengthening internal controls.
-- said shares of Maxim, a franchisor of floor-covering stores, should "at least" perform in line with the market.
-- Maxim was down 1/4 to 11-1/2 early Friday afternoon.
